in_sanskrit.name: Amarchand
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Immortal God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Amarchand एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Amara (Immortal) + Chand (God) The name 'Amarchand' is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a compound of two words: 'Amara' (Immortal) and 'Chand' (God). It signifies a divine being who is immortal and a deity to be revered. In Hindu mythology, the name 'Amarchand' is associated with Lord Shiva, the God of destruction and regeneration. He is the supreme deity and is known to be the immortal god.
